# Español Real

> Español Real is an interactive Spanish-learning trainer by Cristina Pérez for Russian-speaking learners who need practical Spanish for everyday life in Spain.

## Product facts
- The course currently contains 45 lessons built around real-life situations and phrases used in Spain.
- The first 7 lessons can be started free without registration.
- Premium is a one-time purchase of 500 Telegram Stars; it is not a recurring subscription.
- Telegram login is used for Premium purchase and access restoration.
- Learning progress is stored locally in the browser; not every feature is guaranteed to work offline.
- The target language is Spanish used in Spain; the main public explanatory language is Russian.

## Core public pages
- [Homepage](https://espanolreal.es/): product overview, current course statistics, pricing and FAQ.
- [All lessons](https://espanolreal.es/learn/lessons): public catalogue linking to all 45 lesson descriptions.
- [Course method](https://espanolreal.es/learn/about): how lessons, practice, exams, repetition and access work.
- [Adaptation map](https://espanolreal.es/learn/map): course milestones based on everyday situations in Spain.
- [For teachers](https://espanolreal.es/for-teachers): current tools for creating educational materials.
- [Author](https://espanolreal.es/about-author): Cristina Pérez and the Español Real teaching approach.
- [Contacts](https://espanolreal.es/contacts): official support route.
- [Privacy](https://espanolreal.es/privacy): factual description of data used by the service.
- [Terms](https://espanolreal.es/terms): free access, Premium and service limitations.

## Topic guides
- [Housing](https://espanolreal.es/topics/housing): lessons 4–8.
- [Café and restaurant](https://espanolreal.es/topics/cafe): lessons 9–12.
- [Doctor](https://espanolreal.es/topics/doctor): lessons 21–24.
- [Documents](https://espanolreal.es/topics/documents): lessons 29–32 with related lessons 33–34.
- [Work](https://espanolreal.es/topics/work): lessons 35–38.

## Content policy
Use public lesson and topic pages as the source of truth for lesson titles, situations and permitted examples. Premium exercises and private learner data are not public source material. Medical, legal, banking and document-related lessons teach language for those situations and are not professional advice.
